blocks.x: New Official GTA 6 Teaser Released By Rockstar Games

Known as 'Cyberpunk 2077's' biggest fan, Angharad is a Welsh games writer who thrives in anything related to digital storytelling. If a video game explores the intricacies and horrors of womanhood, she is there.
Thanks to previous work at GAMINGbible, GameByte, The Loadout, Game Luster, Angharad has built a strong understanding of both the digital world and what fans want from it and is eager to share her thoughts and expertise with readers.

It is hard to believe that we are rapidly approaching the launch date for Grand Theft Auto VI, especially as it has been a lesson in patience getting to this moment. Not only has it been well over a decade since the launch of the last Grand Theft Auto entry, Grand Theft Auto V, but Grand Theft Auto VI itself has been the victim of two major delays, with the game initially planned to launch in Fall 2025.

However, after long last, Grand Theft Auto VI is expected to launch on 19 November, and with pre-orders done, gameplay revealed, and the hype bigger than ever, we are finally on the homestretch, but there are still some big moments to come.

blocks.c: Jason and Lucia with gun and helicopter in background

blocks.x: That is because, on 29 September, Grand Theft Auto VI fans can look forward to a 14-page feature and 12 new screenshots as part of a Game Informer feature. Not only that, but to celebrate the upcoming promotion, Rockstar has released stunning new artwork of Jason and Lucia themselves.

Released for the upcoming Game Informer cover, the brand-new artwork shows Jason and Lucia against the Vice City skyline. Both sat inside a red car riddled with bullet holes, they both hold their guns ready and look the part of the Bonnie and Clyde-esque story that they are about to embark on.

This cover allowed Game Informer to announce the major 14-page GTA 6 cover story which will be arriving later this month. As well as stunning new art, the magazine will also feature interviews with key Rockstar Games developers who plan to share more on GTA VI's advanced weather systems and even the vast ecosystem players can expect to contend with.

Perhaps most exciting is the news that this Game Informer spread will welcome twelve new screenshots for fans to enjoy, and we can only imagine that this will give us more glimpses of Jason and Lucia, as well as supporting characters, locations, and more.
The Game Informer spread arrives digitally on 29 September, so we only have a few days left to see the most anticipated game of all time in all its glory in never-before-seen images and interviews.

blocks.c: Image shows Jason and Lucia in Game Informer cover

blocks.x: Of course, over the past few years, we have received plenty of promotional images from Grand Theft Auto VI, whether that is courtesy of its official website, or thanks to random drops by Rockstar itself.

Additionally, fans were treated to some more art in recent weeks when Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album was announced. As the only physical release when it comes to GTA VI, fans were quick to snap it up, especially as the cover featured never-before-seen images of Jason and Lucia, and it really does seem as though our new crime duo has already captured the hearts of us all.

As mentioned, Grand Theft Auto VI is expected to launch on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S on 19 November, meaning that we only have just over a month to go until we can finally head to Leonida and experience a once-in-a-lifetime title.

New Official GTA 6 Teaser Released By Rockstar Games

Published Sep 28, 2026, 5:27 AM EDT

Known as 'Cyberpunk 2077's' biggest fan, Angharad is a Welsh games writer who thrives in anything related to digital storytelling. If a video game explores the intricacies and horrors of womanhood, she is there.
Thanks to previous work at GAMINGbible, GameByte, The Loadout, Game Luster, Angharad has built a strong understanding of both the digital world and what fans want from it and is eager to share her thoughts and expertise with readers.

It is hard to believe that we are rapidly approaching the launch date for Grand Theft Auto VI, especially as it has been a lesson in patience getting to this moment. Not only has it been well over a decade since the launch of the last Grand Theft Auto entry, Grand Theft Auto V, but Grand Theft Auto VI itself has been the victim of two major delays, with the game initially planned to launch in Fall 2025.

However, after long last, Grand Theft Auto VI is expected to launch on 19 November, and with pre-orders done, gameplay revealed, and the hype bigger than ever, we are finally on the homestretch, but there are still some big moments to come.

That is because, on 29 September, Grand Theft Auto VI fans can look forward to a 14-page feature and 12 new screenshots as part of a Game Informer feature. Not only that, but to celebrate the upcoming promotion, Rockstar has released stunning new artwork of Jason and Lucia themselves.

Released for the upcoming Game Informer cover, the brand-new artwork shows Jason and Lucia against the Vice City skyline. Both sat inside a red car riddled with bullet holes, they both hold their guns ready and look the part of the Bonnie and Clyde-esque story that they are about to embark on.

This cover allowed Game Informer to announce the major 14-page GTA 6 cover story which will be arriving later this month. As well as stunning new art, the magazine will also feature interviews with key Rockstar Games developers who plan to share more on GTA VI's advanced weather systems and even the vast ecosystem players can expect to contend with.

Perhaps most exciting is the news that this Game Informer spread will welcome twelve new screenshots for fans to enjoy, and we can only imagine that this will give us more glimpses of Jason and Lucia, as well as supporting characters, locations, and more.

The Game Informer spread arrives digitally on 29 September, so we only have a few days left to see the most anticipated game of all time in all its glory in never-before-seen images and interviews.

Of course, over the past few years, we have received plenty of promotional images from Grand Theft Auto VI, whether that is courtesy of its official website, or thanks to random drops by Rockstar itself.

Additionally, fans were treated to some more art in recent weeks when Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album was announced. As the only physical release when it comes to GTA VI, fans were quick to snap it up, especially as the cover featured never-before-seen images of Jason and Lucia, and it really does seem as though our new crime duo has already captured the hearts of us all.

As mentioned, Grand Theft Auto VI is expected to launch on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S on 19 November, meaning that we only have just over a month to go until we can finally head to Leonida and experience a once-in-a-lifetime title.
